articles.title: Keir Starmer: Schachmatt an der Macht

Prime Minister and Labour Leader Keir Starmer is making a major speech in a bid to secure his premiership, following the devastating losses the Labour Party suffered in last week's elections. Starmer says the government "will face up to the big challenges" the country faces after Labour relinquished nearly 1500 seats in local elections across England and power in the Welsh Senedd.
